title: Old-Time: Clocks 'n Bells (and Compasses!)
description: A resourcepack to change and improve the compass and clock textures, as well as the sound of bells! Clocks and compasses turn into golden pocket variants, whereas bells sound a lot more realistic than before
body:
A resource pack retexturing the clock and the (recovery) compass into golden pocket variants, as well as replacing the bell sounds with a more realistic version! Perfect for those searching a more polished look for these items and/or searching for a realistic feel to their builds with bells (especially for those building churches and Halloween-themes)

- The (recovery) compass uses the same system as the vanilla variant. The red arrow points towards the point of interest (spawn, lodestone, last death)
- The clock got remodeled into an actual analog clock, and uses a 16 in-game hours system (2x8 hours, 1 in-game hour = 1.25 real minutes)
- The bell features two sound variants: Light (default) and Heavy. In the extra bell sounds folder you can find both variants to switch between them. Change the audio files in the bell folder (under assets -> Minecraft -> sounds -> block -> bell) to the desired variant to do so.
